newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - INDONESIAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 8.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on August 8. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Indonesian government admits it has tightened monetary policy in the wake of the recent attack on the rupiah and this will be relaxed in a phased manner.
Indonesian Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad has moved to calm investors after the Jakarta stock exchange composite index fell more than three percent on Thursday.
Religious Affairs Minister Tarmizi Taher said followers of Islam and Christianity hold the key to religious harmony in Indonesia.
PT Indosat is said to be negotiating to buy a 40 percent stake in Indonesian Education Television (TPI) controlled by President Suharto's eldest daughter Siti Hariyanti Rukmana.
